numerics._expected_time: Stable convergence with current mesh quality
numerics._comment_co: Co=1.0 OK for bounded schemes (accurate profile)

mesh._comment_resolution: 16 CPD (was 15) to push skewness below 4.0 for coarctation

boundary_layers._comment_yplus: y+=5 relaxed for coarctation (was 1.0) - use wall functions instead of wall-resolved
boundary_layers._comment_layers: 3 layers (was 5) - less aggressive for complex geometry

surface_refinement._comment: Conservative surface refinement (was [1,1]) - allows smoother transitions

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_quality: Ultra-conservative + extra iterations to eliminate last 2 skewed faces
